name: Viking® 15" 160 lb. Panel Ready Ice Maker with Drain Pump
shortDescription: The 15” Craft Ice Machine, designed to deliver the perfect cube for cocktails and spirits. Producing up to 160 artisan-style cubes daily, this unit stores 25 lbs. of crystal-clear ice and features a sleek midnight black interior with Arctic white LED lighting. BrightShield™ antimicrobial lighting helps maintain a more hygienic environment, while a factory-installed drain pump, reversible door, and optional custom panel compatibility ensure easy integration into any space. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY*

features.text: Produces up to 160 clear, slow-melting clear craft cubes per day—perfect for sipped drinks, cocktails, or any drink where clarity and melt rate matter.
Designed to fit flush into cabinetry or install under your counter, giving a seamless, high-end look in modern kitchens.
Built-in drain pump allows flexible installation under-counter or freestanding without needing a gravity drain.
Operates smoothly and quietly so it won’t interfere with the ambiance of entertaining or the calm of your kitchen.
Stores a meaningful amount of ice to keep up with demand—so there’s less waiting when entertaining or during peak use.
Includes alerts for maintenance tasks like cleaning or water checks, helping keep the machine in top shape without guesswork.
